sourceCopy.name: Crossword Online
sourceCopy.title: Free Crossword Online | Play Word Puzzles | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play an original crossword puzzle online. Fill across and down clues, check answers, use hints, and start a fresh locally generated board.
sourceCopy.intro: Solve a fresh, locally generated crossword from a small set of original clues. Select a clue or square, type with your keyboard, and check or reveal answers when you need help.
sourceCopy.summary: A free browser crossword with across and down clues, keyboard controls, hints, answer checks and shuffled boards. It works without an account or puzzle upload.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I play this crossword?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose an across or down clue, then type letters into the selected squares. Use the arrow keys to move within the answer. Check a word or the whole puzzle, reveal one letter or the full answer, or start a new shuffled board.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my answers uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The puzzle, answers and score stay in this browser tab. There is no account, upload, server processing or saved play history.
howTo: Choose a clue from Across or Down, or select a square on the board.
Type letters; use the arrow keys to move inside the selected answer. Switching direction on a crossing square is supported.
Check your word or the full board, use a letter hint, or reveal an answer. Start a new board to reshuffle the original clue set.

fields.rules: Answers ignore spaces and letter case. The clue set is finite and original; a new board rearranges its entries but does not promise an unlimited daily puzzle feed.
fields.keyboard: Keyboard: type a letter, use arrows to move, and press Backspace to clear a square.
fields.empty: No crossword could be built from this language’s available word set. Try a new board or use the English version.

messages.ready: A new crossword is ready. Choose an Across or Down clue to begin.
messages.entryIncorrect: Some letters in this answer do not match yet.
messages.puzzleCorrect: Every answer is correct. Crossword complete!
messages.newGame: A new crossword board is ready.
messages.noHint: This answer has no hidden letters left.
messages.buildFailed: This language’s clue set could not form a connected board. Try New crossword.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this crossword include an unlimited daily puzzle feed?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The page builds shuffled boards from a small, finite set of original clue-and-answer pairs. It does not fetch or claim an unlimited daily puzzle library.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use this crossword without uploading anything?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. The board and your answers run in this browser tab. The tool does not upload your play or require an account.

additionalFaqs.question: Is this a crossword maker?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. This page is for playing clues. Use the separate Crossword Maker when you want to arrange your own answer-and-clue pairs.
